root_idea.summary: An underlying sense of excess and extension: something exceeds a limit or extends in physical size, duration, capacity, rank, or benefit.
root_idea.development: The root develops from physical extension and height to prolonged time, superiority, abundance of means, bounty, and related derived constructions of extending, competing, or displaying superiority.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Form I verb with Quranic occurrences.
Distinct Form VI verb with a Quranic occurrence.
Distinct noun طَوْل with the meaning of means, bounty, and abundance.
Distinct noun طُول denoting physical height or length.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used of a period, age, or time that becomes long or protracted.
The Quranic occurrence describes life or the passing of time becoming prolonged for a people.
In the Quran, applied to a span of activity, night, or time whose duration is extended.

senses.definition: Means, resources, or financial ability sufficient for an undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic marriage context, it denotes the means to obtain and support a free woman, especially the ability to meet the relevant financial obligations.
Used of possession of ample resources, excellence, beneficence, or sustaining power; ذُو الطَّوْل denotes one possessing such abundance or bounty.
In the Quranic expression, it denotes height as the dimension in which the mountains cannot be reached or equaled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become elongated, tall, or high; of anxiety, to persist or remain attached.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form I usage; the physical and figurative extensions are broader than the Quranic temporal occurrences listed under طَالَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exceed or surpass another in height, stature, beneficence, excellence, or rank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive usage, including comparison in physical height or in superiority and distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bestow a benefit, favor, or gift upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the beneficiary introduced by عَلَى or in a comparable benefactive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lengthen, extend, or make something long, tall, or high; also to prolong a period or make speech prolix.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II usage, including extension of objects, continuance in life, assemblies, and discourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lengthen or slacken an animal's tether so that it can range more widely while grazing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction used of a horse or other grazing beast and its tether or rope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant a delay or respite, or to defer an affair, debt, or promise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of prolonging the handling or fulfillment of an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend or vie with another for superiority in height, beneficence, excellence, or rank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III reciprocal usage, with the point of comparison supplied by context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To produce tall offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage said of a woman who gives birth to a tall child or tall children.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tie a horse with a rope or tether.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equestrian construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise or become high by degrees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a building or other structure gradually increasing in height.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stretch oneself upward or extend one's legs in order to see something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily, intentional extension used to gain a higher view or reach branches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To display or boast of superiority, excellence, height, or possessions; to act arrogantly toward another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object of the display may be physical stature, excellence, rank, or something possessed; the construction can include contempt or reviling of others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overbear, overpower, subdue, oppress, or domineer over another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative or hostile use of the construction عَلَيْهِ; it also describes a stallion driving off rival stallions from his mares.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To kill more of an opposing group than they have killed of one's own group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized reciprocal or retaliatory usage with عَلَيْهِمْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie, compete, or contend with one another for superiority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal usage in physical height, beneficence, excellence, or another understood dimension of superiority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extend and rise, as a crack in a wall; of the false dawn, to extend upward without spreading laterally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form X usage; the dawn description distinguishes the elongated false dawn from the laterally spreading dawn.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reckon or regard something as long.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported transitive usage characterized as analogical rather than the basic intransitive lexical construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Length, tallness, height, or extension in a physical or abstract dimension.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applies to people, animals, inanimate things, and ideal attributes such as time; it contrasts with width or shortness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The utmost extent or duration of time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions meaning throughout the longest or whole extent of a period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Longitude of a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical geographical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Length in a camel's upper lip extending beyond the lower lip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description of a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long tether or rope used to restrain a horse or similar beast while it grazes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The rope may be attached to the animal's leg or to a stake, allowing controlled movement within the grazing area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave someone to his own affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative use of relaxing or slackening a tether.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Length of life, absence, tarrying, or delay and flagging in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use referring to the duration of a person's journey, absence, or continued hesitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tedious period or length of time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially in the phrases طِيلٌ يَوْمٌ and طِيلٌ لَيْلَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-ass, especially a wild she-ass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical item attested in poetic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Life or the period of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions wishing that someone's life be prolonged.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A high or elevated state or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Substantivized feminine form of the comparative adjective أَطْوَلُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Long, elongated, tall, or high in physical extent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may describe people, animals, objects, or other extended forms; a horse may be described particularly as long-bodied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a classical Arabic poetic metre.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A postclassical technical designation, so called because the metre is regarded as the longest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long-legged aquatic bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wind's counterwind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed lexical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very or exceptionally tall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a person and stronger in degree than the ordinary adjective طَوِيلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Benefiting, conferring benefit, or providing utility, profit, or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the sense of utility or benefit it is commonly used in negative expressions, meaning useless, ineffective, or not good for anything.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Enmity or a claim to blood-revenge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of seeking blood-revenge from a group or its members.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Exceeding or surpassing in length, height, beneficence, excellence, or giving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparative adjective; it may describe physical extent or the greater scope of generosity and provision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having an upper lip longer than the lower, said of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized physical description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The penis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A halter or bridle rope for a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equestrian noun; its plural denotes horse halters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Far-extending space or a distant limit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression مَدًى مُتَطَاوِلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Elongated; in الفجر المستطيل, the first or false dawn extending upward without lateral spread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the dawn, contrasted with the laterally spreading dawn.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Temporal extension is Quranic; physical and persistent-anxiety branches are classical.
Causative extension, tether, delay, and prolixity branches.
Pointer-only reference to the basic verb.
Stretching upward to see or reach.
Arrogance, oppression, and the specialized killing-more usage.
Extension and rise of a crack or false dawn.
Financial means and broader abundance, power, or excellence, including Quran-attested constructions.
Quranic height plus broader physical and abstract extension.
Illustrative uses only; no independent lexical branch.
Comparative superiority in extent or beneficence.
Analogical usage already grouped with the Form X report.

cautions: The Quranic forms طَوْل and طُول are distinct vocalized nouns: the former denotes means, bounty, or abundance, while the latter denotes physical height in its Quranic occurrence.
The Quranic temporal senses of طَالَ, تَطَاوَلَ, and طَوِيلٌ should not be generalized to all of their broader Classical Arabic physical, comparative, or idiomatic uses.
The reported transitive use of اِسْتَطَالَ meaning “reckon or regard as long” is explicitly characterized in the evidence as analogical.
